source_title: You can get Samsung's Galaxy A37 5G for free with a new line from Metro
source_excerpt:
Phones and other electronic devices are getting more expensive . That makes it even harder to get good prices on more affordable products. That's why it's important to keep an eye out for good deals, especially if it's a product that you're going to use every day.
If you've been trying to get yourself into a new phone but don't want to spend a fortune, the Galaxy A37 5G is an easy one to recommend. Not only do you get great features for the price, but you can now get one for free from Metro by signing up for a plan.
This works better if you also want a new line of service
Now, nothing comes free, but the promotion from Metro comes close. In order to get the Galaxy A37 5G at no charge, you're going to need to activate a new line of service. At minimum, you will need to sign up for the carrier's $40/month plan, which includes unlimited talk, text, and web.
Next, you'll need to port in a number from an existing carrier. Once all of this is complete, you can get the phone for free. Of course, if you don't like the service, you can always cut it off or move to something new. The only catch here is that the phone will remain locked to Metro for an entire year.
After that, it will be free to use with any carrier. It's a long time to wait, so it's best to actually use the phone with Metro in this case. The coverage should be good since it's utilizing T-Mobile's 5G network. We've tested it and found it to work well.
When it comes to the Galaxy A37 5G, this is the phone that's suited for everyone. You get a nice design, an impressive OLED screen, and a powerful triple camera setup. The battery will last most people a couple of days, and you get fast wired charging via USB-C.
This isn't going to be a powerhouse like the Galaxy S26 Ultra, but it will be a reliable phone you can keep with you at all times. The good news is that Samsung will provide six years of OS updates, which means new features for years to come.
Sign up with Metro and get a free Samsung A37 5G for a limited time. This phone delivers on every level and is perfect for most people.
